scope: post-run pin and source review; no runtime rerun or physical claim
checks: entry busy or inherited terminal status refuses without writes
100000 polls; timeout does not clear unknown status
error bits take priority over done
IF preserved and IF-set operations refused
limitations: callback count bound is not an elapsed-time bound
exclusive bus ownership remains a native caller obligation
legacy/new sequence uses modeled write-one-to-clear status
native interrupt/cache/clock handoff and encoder output remain unqualified
